title: Lumacore
features:
⚙️ Gameplay & Automation
Instant Start: Force-start matches with a single click.

Auto Collect: A highly optimized, lag-free loop that automatically gathers Sapphires, Gold, and Amethyst.

Auto Pick Card: Automatically selects random cards between rounds so you can fully AFK.

👥 Multiplayer & Store
Live Player Scanner: A dynamic dropdown that constantly updates to show active players in your server.

Party Controls: Instantly send a join request to any selected player or leave your current party.

Safe Auto-Buy: Select and purchase Basic, Golden, Magic, or Divine chests with built-in cooldowns to prevent double-spending.

⚔️ Combat & Stats
God Mode: Rapidly spams the heal remote to keep you alive through massive damage.

Stat Loops (Level 2+): Maximize your build with lightweight, toggleable loops for Inf Damage, Inf Range, Attack Speed, and Max Health.

Instant Boosts: Instantly inject +100 Ammo or +100 Luck (Spades) using a safe, anti-crash batching system.

🎨 UI & Performance
Zero-Lag Performance: Built with smart yielding loops that will not drain your FPS.

Seamless Toggles: Press RightControl (PC) or use the floating screen icon (Mobile) to instantly hide/show the menu.

Live Info: Displays your Roblox avatar, username, active Game ID, and the game's last updated date.

Failsafes: Actions will safely cancel and flash a red warning notification if the required game remotes haven't loaded yet.
